entry.title: OECD data show graduate unemployment rising for the first time since its records began
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-OECD i-Education at a Glance 2026, eyaphehlelelwa ngomhla wama-29 kuSeptemba 2026, ifumanise ukuba intswela-ngqesho phakathi kwabantu abaneminyaka eyi-25 ukuya kwengama-34 abanesidanga seyunivesithi inyuke ngamanqaku epesenti angama-0.4 kumazwe angamalungu phakathi kuka-2023 no-2025, ngelixa intswela-ngqesho phakathi kwabo banemfundo yesekondari ephakamileyo kuphela yehle ngamanqaku epesenti angama-0.2. Oku kunciphise umsantsa oqhelekileyo, kwaye kokokuqala ukuguquka okunjalo kubonakala ukususela oko olu ludweliso lwamanani lwaqala ngo-2000. UMzantsi Korea ubonisa le meko ngokucacileyo: ama-71.1% abantu bawo abaneminyaka eyi-25 ukuya kwengama-34 banesiqinisekiso semfundo ephakamileyo, ngaphezulu kakhulu komyinge we-OECD wama-47.5%, kodwa izinga lawo lokuqeshwa kwabaphumelele izidanga elingama-80.1% lingaphantsi komyinge we-OECD wama-86%.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, olu lolona phawu lucacileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku kuwo onke amazwe e-OECD lokuba inzuzo yesidanga kwimarike yemisebenzi iyancipha kanye ngeli xesha i-AI iguqula imisebenzi yabaqalayo, umkhwa ekufuneka i-Wits AHEAD iwulandele ithelekisa nedatha yaseMzantsi Afrika ngokwawo malunga nokuba baya phi na abaphumelele izidanga.

OECD, Education at a Glance 2026 (via UPI) · Intergovernmental body data, reported by an international wire service

entry.title: Côte d'Ivoire launches UNESCO-backed AI training for 3,000 vocational education teachers
entry.summary:
UMphathiswa (Minister Delegate) weMfundo yezoBugcisa noQeqesho lweZakhono zoMsebenzi waseCôte d'Ivoire, uJean-Louis Moulot, uphehlelele inkqubo ngomhla wama-25 kuSeptemba 2026 yokuqeqesha ootitshala bemfundo yezakhono zomsebenzi, abaongameli bezokufundisa nabalawuli abangama-3,000 kwi-AI, ngenkxaso yobugcisa evela kwi-UNESCO. Isigaba sokuqala siqhuba ukusuka ngomhla woku-1 ku-Okthobha ukuya kowama-30 kuDisemba 2026, siqeqesha ootitshala abali-1,000 e-Abidjan kwiziseko ze-AI, ukusetyenziswa kwayo kwezemfundo, iindlela zovavanyo, imigaqo yokuziphatha nokhuseleko lwedatha, phambi kokuba le nkqubo yolingo ihlolwe ukuze yandiswe kwilizwe liphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, le yinkqubo enqabileyo ekhokelwa ngurhulumente nexhaswa yi-UNESCO eqeqesha abaqeqeshi bootitshala ngokwabo, hayi abafundi babo kuphela, imodeli i-Wits AHEAD enokufunda kuyo kumsebenzi wayo neekholeji zezobugcisa nezakhono zomsebenzi zaseMzantsi Afrika.

TrendsnAfrica · Government programme launch with UNESCO technical support, reported by regional press

entry.title: Ghana commits to train 100,000 TVET facilitators in AI under new UNESCO and Microsoft partnership
entry.summary:
I-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Service yaseGhana isayine isivumelwano sokuqondana (memorandum of understanding) ne-UNESCO, i-KPMG ne-Microsoft ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026 sokuqeqesha ubuncinane abaququzeleli be-TVET abangama-100,000 kwi-AI nakwizakhono zedijithali phantsi kwenkqubo i-AI EmpowerED. Umlawuli-jikelele we-TVET Service, uGqr Eric Kofi Adzroe, uthe olu budlelwane luphawula utshintsho olusingise kwinkqubo engqamene noshishino, eqhutywa yitekhnoloji kwaye egxile kwiziphumo, ngelixa ummeli we-UNESCO kwelo lizwe, uEdmond Moukala, etyikitye isivumelwano egameni lalo mbutho.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, ukuxhobisa abahlohli bezobugcisa nezakhono zomsebenzi ngezakhono ze-AI kweli nqanaba kunokuguqula indlela isizukulwana sonke samagcisa neengcali zobugcisa zaseAfrika esingena ngayo kwimarike yemisebenzi eguqulwa yi-AI, imodeli i-Wits AHEAD eyibukeleyo ifuna izifundo ezinokusebenza kwicandelo le-TVET laseMzantsi Afrika.

Graphic Online · National press, government partnership announcement

entry.title: US learning platform data shows AI tools trail far behind other classroom technology
entry.summary:
Ingxelo entsha ye-Instructure i-EdTech Top 40, esekelwe kwidatha engachazi magama yabasebenzisi bemfundo ephakamileyo abazizigidi ezili-19.5 beqonga lokufunda i-Canvas phakathi kukaSeptemba 2025 no-Epreli 2026, ifumanise ukuba i-Google Gemini, esona sixhobo se-AI esizimeleyo esamkelwe kakhulu, ifikelele kubasebenzisi abangama-87,788 kuphela kumaziko angama-211, yaye ayikwazanga kungena kwizixhobo ezidityanisiweyo eziyi-100 eziphambili. Izixhobo esele zisaziwa ezifana ne-McGraw Hill, enabasebenzisi abazizigidi ezili-11.3, uvavanyo lweekhosi lwe-Watermark ne-Zoom zahlala zisetyenziswa ngokubanzi ngakumbi. Usekela-mongameli we-Instructure, uRyan Lufkin, uthe iiyunivesithi zityikitya izivumelwano ze-AI zeziko lonke ngaphandle kokuba zibe sele zifake ezi zixhobo kumsebenzi weekhosi wemihla ngemihla.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, umsantsa phakathi kweelayisensi ze-AI zamaziko nokusetyenziswa kwayo okwenyani eklasini sisilumkiso i-Wits AHEAD esilandelayo: ukuthenga ukufikelela kwizixhobo ze-AI akufani nokuzidibanisa nokufundisa novavanyo, kwaye umsebenzi weqela ngokwalo malunga nokwamkelwa ngokusebenzayo uthetha ngqo ngalo msantsa.

Inside Higher Ed · Established press report on industry usage data

entry.title: UNESCO programme trains over 100 rural teachers and principals across China and Southeast Asia in AI and STEM
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ixele ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026 ukuba i-China-Southeast Asia Capacity Development Programme for Teachers and Principals yayo, eyabanjwa eBeijing ukusuka kowe-17 ukuya kowama-23 kuAgasti 2026 phantsi komxholo othi 'STEM and AI: Empowering Rural Teachers for Digital Transformation', ihlanganise abenzi bemigaqo-nkqubo yemfundo, iinkokeli zezikolo, ootitshala neengcali ezingaphezu kwe-100 abavela e-China nakumazwe aseMzantsi-mpuma Asia. Iququzelelwe kunye ne-International Research and Training Centre for Rural Education ye-UNESCO, i-SEAMEO RECSAM, i-UNESCO Chair on Artificial Intelligence in Education eBeijing Normal University kunye ne-OECD, le nkqubo igxile ekusebenziseni i-AI nokufundisa i-STEM ukuze kuqhubele phambili ulingano lwedijithali kwiindawo zasemaphandleni ezingafumani nkonzo yaneleyo. UNjingalwazi Shahbaz Khan, umlawuli we-Regional Office for East Asia ye-UNESCO, ubize 'i-AI egxile ebantwini, enemigaqo yokuziphatha nebandakanya wonke umntu kwimfundo'.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, ukugxininisa kwale nkqubo ukuba itekhnoloji inokuxhasa kodwa ingaze ithathe indawo yootitshala basemaphandleni kunika imodeli i-Wits AHEAD enokuyisebenzisa kumsebenzi wayo wokulungiselela abaqeqeshi bootitshala kwiindawo ezingenazixhobo zaneleyo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: Ethiopia's Education Ministry says AI will support, not replace, teachers as it expands digital learning
entry.summary:
UMphathiswa wezeMfundo wase-Ethiopia, uBerhanu Nega, uthe ngomhla wama-29 kuSeptemba 2026 ootitshala kulo lonke ilizwe baxhaswa ukuba basebenzise i-AI ekulungiseleleni izifundo, ekuphuhliseni umxholo, ekuxhaseni abafundi nakuvavanyo, kunye nokwenziwa kwedijithali kwe-Education and Higher Education Management Information Systems zesebe. UMphathiswa ugxininise ukuba i-AI iziswa ukuze yomeleze amandla ootitshala, hayi ukubathatha indawo, njengenxalenye yomzamo obanzi wokufunda kwi-intanethi, ukufunda okuxubileyo nokufunda ngeziqinisekiso ezincinci (micro credentials), kunye noqhagamshelwano lwedijithali olomeleleyo kwiiyunivesithi nezikolo. Ubize ukuba inkqubo yemfundo idlule ekufundeni ngentloko, iphuhlise abantu abacinga nzulu abakwaziyo 'ukusebenza kunye noomatshini'.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, nakwiNtsika 5, uhlalutyo nedatha kwiinkqubo zemfundo, isebe likazwelonke elizibophelela esidlangalaleni kwi-AI njengenkxaso kootitshala endaweni yokubathatha indawo, kunye nohlaziyo lwedatha kwinqanaba leenkqubo, luhlobo lophawu lomgaqo-nkqubo i-Wits AHEAD elulandelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi wonke.

allAfrica (Ethiopian News Agency) · National press, government ministry announcement

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI solutions rather than import them, says UN scientific panel member
entry.summary:
UGirmaw Abebe Tadesse, okhokela i-AI for Good Lab ye-Microsoft eKenya nolilungu le-Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence yeZizwe eziManyeneyo, uxelele i-UN News ngexesha le-UN High Level Week eNew York ngomhla wama-25 kuSeptemba 2026 ukuba amazwe aseAfrika kufuneka achonge iingxaki zawo phambi kokwamkela itekhnoloji eyilwe kwezinye iindawo. Uthe abachaphazelekayo, kuquka amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, oorhulumente, amaqabane ophuhliso neenkampani zetekhnoloji, kufuneka bahlanganise ulwazi lwabo ukuze bakhe izisombululo ezifanele iimeko zalapho endaweni yokuphinda umzamo omnye, kwaye walatha kubantu abaselula baseAfrika njengomthombo wezinto ezintsha esele usebenzisa itekhnoloji kwimingeni yoluntu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, umcebisi wezenzululwazi we-UN obiza iiyunivesithi ngokucacileyo njengamaqabane abalulekileyo kwi-ajenda ye-AI ekhokelwa ngabantu balapho womeleza isizathu sokugxininisa kwe-Wits AHEAD kuphando nezisombululo ezingabaseAfrika, hayi izakhelo ezingeniswe zivela kwamanye amazwe.

allAfrica (UN News) · UN News Service, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Cape Town hosts first African THE World Academic Summit as Wits and four other South African universities rise in the world rankings
entry.summary:
I-Times Higher Education World Academic Summit ivulwe kwi-University of Cape Town ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026, okokuqala ukuba lo msitho ubanjelwe kwilizwekazi laseAfrika, kunye nokuphehlelelwa kwe-THE World University Rankings 2027. Iiyunivesithi ezintlanu zaseMzantsi Afrika ngoku zikwiiyunivesithi ezingama-500 eziphambili ehlabathini, kuquka i-Wits ekwindawo ye-301 ukuya kweye-325, ngelixa i-University of Cape Town inyuke yaya kwindawo ye-147 ekwabelwana ngayo, eyona ndawo yayo intle kwiminyaka esixhenxe. USekela-Ngqonyela we-UCT, uMosa Moshabela, uthe iyunivesithi icime izixhobo zayo zokubona i-AI ukuze igxile ekufundiseni abafundi ukusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela efanelekileyo, ngelixa uMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo uButi Manamela ephawule ukuba abantu abatsha abathandathu kwabalishumi eMzantsi Afrika abaqeshwanga.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, isigqibo se-UCT sokuyeka ukubona i-AI ukuze kufundiswe ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanelekileyo siphawula utshintsho kumgaqo-nkqubo wovavanyo i-Wits AHEAD elulandelayo kulo lonke icandelo, kwaye ukunyuka kumanqanaba kunye nenani lentswela-ngqesho elichazwe nguMphathiswa kugxininisa isizathu sokuba i-AI, uhlalutyo nesakhono sabaphumelele izidanga zibalulekile kuyo yonke iyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika, kuquka i-Wits.

Daily Maverick · Established press

entry.title: Alliance for African Partnership meets in Dar es Salaam and puts AI skills at the centre of regional cooperation

category.term: Africa (Tanzania, hosted by the University of Dar es Salaam)

entry.summary:
I-Alliance for African Partnership, umanyano lweeyunivesithi ezili-12 ezivela kumazwe ali-10 aseAfrika olusekelwe yi-Michigan State University, ibambe intlanganiso yayo yonyaka ka-2026 kwi-University of Dar es Salaam ukusuka kowe-16 ukuya kowama-22 kuSeptemba. USekela-Ngqonyela woPhando uNelson Boniface uxelele abathunywa ukuba iiyunivesithi kufuneka zihlaziye iikharityhulam zazo kwaye ziqeqeshe abahlohli ukuze abaphumelele izidanga bangashiywa ngasemva yi-AI, esongeza ukuba ulwazi lwe-AI ngoku sisakhono esifunwa ngumfundi wonke, hayi zizazinzulu zekhompyutha kuphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, isibongozo se-Alliance sohlaziyo lwekharityhulam noqeqesho lwabahlohli kumazwe alishumi aseAfrika sivumelana nesizathu se-Wits AHEAD sokufaka ulwazi lwe-AI kuzo zonke izifundo, hayi kwi-STEM kuphela, ukuze abaphumelele izidanga baseAfrika bahlale beqesheka.

allAfrica.com, from the Daily News (Tanzania) · Established African news service

entry.title: Morgan State University wins 10 million dollar federal grant to build a trusted AI research institute
entry.summary:
I-Morgan State University, iyunivesithi yabantu abaNtsundu ngokwembali (historically Black university) eBaltimore, ifumene inkxaso-mali yomanyano lwase-United States engangeedola ezizigidi ezili-10 ukuseka i-Institute for Trusted Autonomous Networks, eyaziwa ngokuba yi-TITAN, ngokwesibhengezo seesenetha zase-US uChris Van Hollen noAngela Alsobrooks ngomhla we-16 kuSeptemba 2026. Le nkxaso-mali yeminyaka emihlanu ixhasa uphando noqeqesho lwezidanga zobugqirha kwi-AI, kukhuseleko lwe-intanethi (cybersecurity) nakukhuseleko oluphuculwe yi-quantum, kwaye injongo yayo kukunceda i-Morgan State ifikelele kwinqanaba eliphezulu leeyunivesithi zophando zaseMelika.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, ukugxila kwe-TITAN ekuqeqesheni abaphandi bezidanga zobugqirha kwiyunivesithi yabantu abaNtsundu ngokwembali kubonisa indlela inkxaso-mali ekujoliswe kuyo yophando lwe-AI enokwandisa ngayo uluhlu lwabo bakhokela uphando lwe-AI, umbuzo i-Wits AHEAD ewulandelayo malunga nolingano kwi-STEM kwihlabathi liphela.

CBS News Baltimore · Established press

entry.title: MIT trains faculty from other universities to teach AI across disciplines
entry.summary:
I-MIT Stephen A. Schwarzman College of Computing iqhube ngokolingo ucweyo lweveki enye oluqeqesha abafundisi abavela kwezinye iikholeji neeyunivesithi ukufundisa i-AI nokufunda koomatshini (machine learning) kwizifundo zabo, besebenzisa izixhobo eziguqulelwe kwikhosi ye-MIT ethi "Modelling with Machine Learning". Ucweyo lokuqala ngoJulayi 2026 luhlanganise izifundiswa ezili-19 ezivela kumaziko asixhenxe, kuquka i-Allen University, i-Babson College, i-Brandeis University kunye ne-University of Massachusetts at Lowell, nabahlohli be-MIT abangaphezu kwesithandathu abafundise iiseshoni ezigubungela ezemali, isayensi yekhompyutha nozinzo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, le nkqubo yolingo ijongana nesithintelo i-Wits AHEAD nayo ejongene naso: izifundiswa ezingaphandle kwesayensi yekhompyutha zidinga uqeqesho olusebenzayo nolwezandla phambi kokuba zikwazi ukufundisa ulwazi lwe-AI ngokuthembekileyo kwizifundo zazo.

MIT News · University announcement

entry.title: UNESCO survey finds most Latin American and Caribbean universities use AI, but few have a strategy
entry.summary:
I-International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC) ye-UNESCO, isebenzisana ne-United Nations University Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability, yenze uphando kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo angama-200 kumazwe ali-19 yaze yapapasha iziphumo zayo ngomhla wesi-8 kuSeptemba 2026 ngexesha le-Digital Learning Week ye-UNESCO. Ifumanise ukuba ama-87% amaziko sele esebenzisa i-AI kwicandelo elinye ubuncinane lomsebenzi wawo, ubukhulu becala ekufundiseni nasekufundeni, kodwa ama-26% kuphela anesicwangciso esisesikweni se-AI. Uninzi lwemizamo ye-AI luqalwa zizifundiswa, ngabaphandi okanye ngabafundi ngabanye, hayi ziinkokeli zamaziko.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, umsantsa phakathi kokusetyenziswa kwe-AI phantse kuyo yonke indawo nolawulo olusesikweni eLatin America naseCaribbean ubonakalisa ipatheni i-Wits AHEAD eyilandelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi wonke, apho isenzo semihla ngemihla sihamba phambi komgaqo-nkqubo wamaziko.

UNESCO IESALC and United Nations University · Intergovernmental higher education body report

entry.title: University of Colorado system adopts a living policy for responsible use of AI
entry.summary:
I-Administrative Policy Statement 6012 entsha ye-University of Colorado system, ethi Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence, iqale ukusebenza ngomhla wama-24 kuAgasti 2026 yaze yachazwa kwibhlogi yemigaqo-nkqubo yeyunivesithi ngomhla wama-21 kuSeptemba. Imisela okulindelekileyo kuyo yonke inkqubo malunga nengqibelelo yezemfundo, ukhuseleko lwedatha, ukungafihlisi nokuqinisekisa ukuchaneka komxholo oveliswe yi-AI, kwaye ichazwa ngokucacileyo njengomgaqo-nkqubo ekujongwe ukuba uguquke njengoko kufika izimvo ezivela kubafundi nabasebenzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo nengqibelelo, inkqubo enkulu yeyunivesithi kawonkewonke ekhetha ukuphatha imithetho yayo ye-AI njengoxwebhu oluphilayo endaweni yomgaqo-nkqubo ongaguqukiyo ngumzekelo wokuthelekisa ovela kuMntla weHlabathi kwiinketho zolawulo i-Wits AHEAD ezilandelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

University of Colorado · University policy announcement

entry.title: University of Pretoria trains future teachers in "prompt literacy" for the AI classroom
entry.summary:
Abaphandi kwi-Department of Early Childhood Education ye-University of Pretoria, abakhokelwa nguGqr Joyce West noGqr Kayla Willemse, baqhuba uphononongo lwezigaba ezininzi malunga nolwazi lokubhala imiyalelo (prompt literacy), isakhono sokunika i-AI evelisayo imiyalelo ecacileyo ngelixa kugwetywa ngokunzulu oko ikuvelisayo. Le projekthi iqeqesha ootitshala bexesha elizayo ukuba basebenzise i-AI njengesixhobo sentsebenziswano eklasini endaweni yokuyibona njengesoyikiso, ngemisebenzi efana nokwakha amabali abantwana nezixhobo zedijithali, ngelixa kubekwa iliso elibukhali kukuthambekela okungalunganga (bias), ukungachaneki nelungelo lokushicilela (copyright) kwinto eveliswa yi-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, olu phononongo lujongana nomsantsa i-Wits AHEAD ewubeke esweni: ingaba ootitshala abatsha bayafundiswa na indlela yokuthandabuza nokubuza ngeziphumo ze-AI, hayi nje indlela yokuzivelisa.

Future SA, reporting University of Pretoria research · South African higher education press, reporting university research

entry.title: East African universities and Arizona State University partner to build "AI-ready" higher education
entry.summary:
I-Inter-University Council for East Africa, iqumrhu lemfundo ephakamileyo le-East African Community, ibhengeze ubudlelwane ngomhla we-9 kuSeptemba 2026 ne-University Design Institute ye-Arizona State University ukunceda iiyunivesithi zaseMpuma Afrika zilungele i-AI. Lo msebenzi ugubungela iinkalo ezine: ubunkokeli nolawulo, uphuhliso lwabafundisi, iinkqubo zophando ezixhasanayo (research ecosystems) nokufunda phakathi kwamaziko. I-Design Institute iza namava avela kumazwe angama-26 nakumaziko angaphezu kwe-140, kuquka asixhenxe eAfrika.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 5, uhlalutyo nedatha kwiinkqubo zemfundo nokwenza izigqibo, olu budlelwane lubonisa iqumrhu lengingqi lemfundo ephakamileyo elakha amandla e-AI kwiiyunivesithi ezininzi ngaxeshanye, imodeli i-Wits AHEAD enokuyithelekisa nokufikelela kwayo eMazantsi eAfrika.

Inter-University Council for East Africa · Intergovernmental higher education body announcement

entry.title: Maharashtra sets up a state committee to govern AI and data dashboards across its universities
entry.summary:
I-Higher and Technical Education Department yaseMaharashtra ikhuphe isigqibo sikarhulumente (government resolution) esiseka i-AI, Data Analytics and Dashboard Governance Committee, eyongamelwe nguNjingalwazi Rajnish Kamat, usekela-ngqonyela we-Shivaji University, eKolhapur. Kwixesha layo leminyaka emithathu, le komiti enamalungu alithoba kufuneka imisele isicwangciso se-AI sephondo, ikhethe ukusetyenziswa okuphambili kwe-AI evelisayo, ukufunda koomatshini nokuqhubekiswa kolwimi lwendalo (natural language processing), ilinganise idatha kwiideshibhodi ezikhoyo zephondo zabafundi, zeemviwo nezezibonelelo zemfundo, kwaye yakhe uhlalutyo oluzenzekelayo lwemikhwa noqikelelo lomngcipheko kwiportal ngoku exela amanani kuphela, ngelixa ihlangabezana nemithetho yokhuseleko lwe-intanethi nobumfihlo. Inika ingxelo rhoqo kwikota kumagosa aphezulu kakhulu karhulumente kweli sebe.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 5, uhlalutyo nedatha kwiinkqubo zemfundo nokwenza izigqibo, lo ngomnye woorhulumente bamaphondo bokuqala naphi na ukubeka ikomiti esisigxina nephendulayo ukuba iphathe ukuguqulwa kwedeshibhodi yeengxelo ibe yinkqubo yokwenene yesilumkiso kwangethuba neyokuxhasa izigqibo, imodeli i-Wits AHEAD enokwalatha kuyo xa ixoxa ngotshintsho olufanayo eMzantsi Afrika.

Government of Maharashtra, Higher and Technical Education Department · State government resolution, reported by regional press

entry.title: Telkom Foundation, BCX and Alibaba Cloud partner with Wits to give students AI-powered coding tools
entry.summary:
I-Telkom Foundation, i-BCX ne-Alibaba Cloud zisebenzisana ne-University of the Witwatersrand ukunika abafundi beComputer Science abakunyaka wesithathu abamalunga ne-165 ukufikelela kwiqonga lophuhliso i-Qoder elixhaswa yi-AI le-Alibaba kwiiprojekthi zabo zesoftware zezifundo. I-Qoder Programme ijolise ekunikeni abafundi amava ezandla ngezixhobo zokubhala ikhowudi ezincediswa yi-AI phambi kokuba bangene kwindawo yomsebenzi apho ezo zixhobo sele ziqhelekile, nokomeleza unxibelelwano phakathi kwekharityhulam ye-Wits nendlela ushishino olusebenza ngayo. UNjingalwazi Richard Klein, intloko ye-Wits School of Computer Science and Applied Mathematics, uthe ikharityhulam kufuneka iguquke ihambisana nolu phuhliso lwehlabathi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, eli linyathelo eliphathekayo elithathwa yi-Wits ngokwayo ukuvala umsantsa phakathi koko kufundwa ngabaphumelele izidanga zesayensi yekhompyutha nemisebenzi yobunjineli besoftware eyomelezwe yi-AI abaya kungena kuyo, kwinqanaba i-Wits AHEAD enokulilandela nokwakha phezu kwalo.

Wits University · University announcement

entry.title: Systematic review of 124 studies finds AI's value in education depends on governance, not the technology, and flags a Global South research gap

category.term: Global (evidence base: Central Asia, East Africa)

entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucwangcisiweyo olubalisayo (systematic narrative review) lwabaphandi abasekwe kwiiyunivesithi zaseKazakhstan, e-Uzbekistan naseTanzania luhlanganise izifundo ezili-124 ezapapashwa phakathi kukaJanuwari 2020 noJanuwari 2026 malunga nendlela i-AI eguqula ngayo imfundo. Lufumanise utshintsho lokwenyani kodwa olungalinganiyo olusuka kwizixhobo ze-AI ezizimeleyo lusingise kwindlela yokufundisa eziqhelanisayo nesekelwe kwidatha, lwaza lwagqiba kwelokuba ingaba olu tshintsho luyabanceda na okanye luyabenzakalisa abafundi kuxhomekeke kulawulo nakwimeko yeziko, hayi kwitekhnoloji ngokwayo, nokuba ukugweba komntu nendima katitshala kufuneka kuhlale kungundoqo endaweni yokuphatha i-AI njengegunya elizimeleyo. Ababhali bakwafumanise ukuba isiseko sobungqina ngokwaso sithambekele kakhulu kubuphengululi bolwimi lwesiNgesi, apho iimbono zoMzantsi weHlabathi, zemveli nezeelwimi ezininzi zisaswele kakhulu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, oku kukuqinisekiswa okuhlolwe ziingcali, okuvela kubaphandi ngokwabo abaseMbindi Asia naseMpuma Afrika, komsantsa wobungqina kanye okhuthaza umsebenzi we-Wits AHEAD: uncwadi olujoliswe ekukhokeleni umgaqo-nkqubo we-AI kwimfundo aluquki ngokwaneleyo amazwi oMzantsi weHlabathi ekufuneka lukhokelwe ngawo.

Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Business schools bring back oral defences as AI use rises
entry.summary:
Izikolo zoshishino eziphambili zaseYurophu, phakathi kwazo i-Insead, i-Imperial College Business School ne-HEC Paris, zibuyisela ukukhusela umsebenzi ngomlomo (oral defences), iimviwo zepeni nephepha novavanyo olubekwe esweni ngokusondeleyo kuba i-AI evelisayo ijongele phantsi isifundo-meko esiqhelekileyo esenziwa ekhaya (take-home case study). UPeter Todd we-Imperial uthe abasebenzi abasakwazi ukuqiniseka ukuba umsebenzi obhaliweyo ongenisiweyo umele ntoni ngaphandle kokuba abafundi bawukhusela bebonakala okanye bawubhale bebekwe esweni, kwaye i-HEC Paris ngoku itshintshana phakathi kovavanyo olwenziwa ngeekhompyutha nolwenziwa ngaphandle kwazo. I-Graduate Management Admission Council ithe imigangatho yovavanyo kufuneka icace ngakumbi ukuze iziqinisekiso zoshishino zigcine intsingiselo yazo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, oku kubonisa izikolo zoshishino eziphambili zisishiya ngokupheleleyo uvavanyo olwenziwa ekhaya endaweni yokululungisa kancinci, nto leyo ebalulekileyo ngqo kwindlela i-Wits AHEAD eyila ngayo isikhokelo sengqibelelo yovavanyo kwiiyunivesithi zaseAfrika ezijongene noxinzelelo olufanayo zinezixhobo ezimbalwa kakhulu zeemviwo zomlomo okanye ezibekwe esweni.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: African curriculum experts meet in Dar es Salaam to confront the AI challenge in teacher education
entry.summary:
INkomfa yesiThandathu ye-African Curriculum Association ibibanjelwe eDar es Salaam ukusuka kowama-22 ukuya kowama-25 kuSeptemba 2026, ihlanganisa abaphuhlisi bekharityhulam, abaqeqeshi bootitshala, abaphandi nabenzi bemigaqo-nkqubo abavela kulo lonke ilizwekazi. Umlawuli-jikelele we-Tanzania Institute of Education uGqr Aneth Komba nonobhala-jikelele we-ACA uGqr Gertrude Namubiru bakhokele iingxoxo malunga nendlela iikharityhulam zaseAfrika nokulungiselelwa kootitshala ekufuneka ziziqhelanise ngayo ne-AI notshintsho olukhawulezayo lwetekhnoloji ngelixa zihlala zisekelwe kwizakhono zalapho nakwiimfuno zoluntu. Inkomfa ibijolise ekuveliseni i-Dar es Salaam Declaration on Education Transformation in Africa, engqamene ne-Agenda 2063 ye-African Union neNjongo yesine yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo (Sustainable Development Goal).

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, intlanganiso yelizwekazi lonke ebeka indlela ukulungiselelwa kootitshala ngokwako ekufuneka kutshintshe ngayo kwiklasi elolongwe yi-AI ithetha ngqo nomsebenzi we-Wits AHEAD malunga noko abaqeqeshi bootitshala kufuneka bakwazi, hayi nje oko abantwana besikolo nabafundi kufuneka bakufundiswe.

The Citizen (Tanzania) · Established national press

entry.title: Universities must teach people to work ‘with AI, not for AI’, says King's College London head
entry.summary:
Ethetha kwi-2026 Korea Times Global Conference eSeoul, uSekela-Ngqonyela we-King's College London uShitij Kapur uthe iiyunivesithi kufuneka ziqinisekise ukuba abantu basebenza ne-AI kunokuba basebenzele yona. Uchaze uxanduva oluhlanu lweeyunivesithi: ukuchaza ngokutsha into ethethwa kukufunda, ukulungiselela abaphumelele izidanga kwimarike yemisebenzi eguqukayo, ukukhusela ubuphengululi obucingisisiweyo, ukuqhubela phambili i-AI yokulungelwa kwabantu bonke nokuqinisekisa ukuba itekhnoloji yomeleza endaweni yokuthatha indawo yesakhono somntu. UKapur uxoxe ukuba uphuhliso lwe-AI aluqingqwanga kwangaphambili, nokuba iiyunivesithi namazwe zisenako ukulolonga indlela eyakhiwa nesetyenziswa ngayo endaweni yokuyamkela nje ivela kushishino lwetekhnoloji.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, usekela-ngqonyela ophambili obeka iiyunivesithi embindini wokulolonga i-AI endaweni yokusabela kuyo nje uxhasa isizathu se-Wits AHEAD sokuba imfundo ephakamileyo kuMzantsi weHlabathi kufuneka incede ukumisela imiqathango yokwamkelwa kwe-AI, hayi nje ukufunxa izixhobo ezakhiwe kwezinye iindawo.

University World News · Established higher education press

entry.title: Latin America's universities embrace AI faster than they can govern it, new study finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwe-UNESCO IESALC lwamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo angama-200 kumazwe ali-19 aseLatin America naseCaribbean lufumanise ukuba ama-87% sele esebenzisa i-AI kwinxalenye ethile yomsebenzi wawo, kodwa ama-26% kuphela anesakhelo esisesikweni se-AI. Ukwamkelwa kuphezulu kakhulu kwiiyunivesithi zabucala ezingenzi nzuzo, kuma-84%, xa kuthelekiswa nama-68% kumaziko karhulumente nama-52% kubaboneleli babucala abenza inzuzo, kwaye ama-55% eeyunivesithi xa zizonke azinalo uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwe-AI oluzinikeleyo. UBorhene Chakroun we-UNESCO uthe ukwandisa iinzuzo kuxhomekeke kutyalo-mali oluqhubekayo ekufikeleleni nasekwakheni amandla, kunye nolawulo oluqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okunemigaqo yokuziphatha, ukungafihlisi nokuphendula.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, oku kubonisa umsantsa i-Wits AHEAD elumkisa ngawo usiba nzulu kwinqanaba elikhulu: iiyunivesithi zikarhulumente, ezisebenzela abafundi abaneenketho ezimbalwa kakhulu, zamkela i-AI ngokukhawuleza eklasini ngelixa zisemva kakhulu kulawulo, kuqeqesho nakwinkxaso-mali yokuyisebenzisa ngoxanduva.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press, reporting a UNESCO IESALC study

entry.title: African universities can drive talent development at scale, Mastercard Foundation tells Accra convening
entry.summary:
Kwi-Higher Education Transformation Convening yokuqala e-Accra ngomhla wama-22 kuSeptemba 2026, uGqr John Nkengasong we-Mastercard Foundation uchaze iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika 'njengeenjini zempumelelo' nesiseko sobutyebi babantu (human capital) ekufuneka zihambelanise ukufundisa neemarike zemisebenzi noshishino. Lo msitho uwonge amaziko amahlanu nge-Africa Higher Education for Transformation (AHEFT) Prize: i-Addis Ababa University, i-2iE, i-Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, i-Muni University ne-University of Rwanda. Isiseko siphinde sachaza injongo yaso yokunceda abantu abatsha baseAfrika abazizigidi ezingama-30, ama-70% kubo engabasetyhini, ukuba bangene emsebenzini onesidima ngo-2030.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, umxhasi omkhulu ochaza iiyunivesithi njengesiseko seetalente, ngelixa ebiza i-AI njengamandla aguqula umsebenzi, womeleza isizathu sobungqina be-Wits AHEAD malunga nokuba zeziphi izakhono zabaphumelele izidanga ezikhokelela ngokwenene kumsebenzi onesidima kwiimarike zemisebenzi zaseAfrika.

University World News · Established higher education press

entry.title: 'Syncopathy' and AI: African HE must choose verification
entry.summary:
Ebhala kwi-University World News, uGqr Kende Kefale we-University of Cape Town uqamba igama elithi 'syncopathy' kwiziphumo ze-AI, ezifana nezicatshulwa neengxoxo, ezibonakala zikholeleka kodwa ziweqa ukuqinisekiswa, aze axoxe ukuba iiyunivesithi zinesiphene esifanayo kuba ukuhlola umsebenzi kuyabiza kwaye akubonakali, ngelixa ukuvelisa kungabizi kwaye kulula ukukubala. Ucebisa ukuba amaziko abhengeze ukuba ungakanani umsebenzi ohlolwa ngabantu phambi kokuba kunikezelwe iziqinisekiso, ukuba yonke inkqubo yokubona ezenzekelayo ibe nomntu onegama ophendulayo ngeempazamo zayo, nokuba iirekhodi zokuqinisekisa zibe yimveliso yeziko ehlala ixesha elide. Ubalula i-draft National AI Policy yaseMzantsi Afrika, eyarhoxiswa ngo-Epreli 2026 emva kokuba kufunyenwe izicatshulwa eziqanjiweyo kuluhlu lwayo lweembekiselo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, le ngxoxo inika i-Wits AHEAD isakhelo esisebenzayo solawulo lwe-AI kwiiyunivesithi zaseAfrika, esibeka iindleko zokuqinisekisa noxanduva lwezigwebo ezizenzekelayo kumaziko endaweni yokuzibeka kubafundi.

University World News · Commentary by a University of Cape Town academic in established higher education press

entry.title: From AI use to funding cuts: how provosts are navigating 2026
entry.summary:
Uphononongo luka-2026 lwe-Inside Higher Ed lwamagosa aphezulu ezemfundo angama-376, olwenziwa yi-Hanover Research, lufumanise ukuba malunga nasixhenxe kwabalishumi abaphathi bezemfundo (provosts) basebenzisa i-AI emsebenzini wabo ubuncinane kanye ngeveki, kodwa omnye kuphela kwabalishumi uthi iziko lakhe linesicwangciso se-AI esisembindini. Ama-12% kuphela axela inzuzo kwiinkqubo zomsebenzi zamasebe ngenxa yotyalo-mali lweziko kwi-AI, ama-8% axela utshintsho kwiziko lonke, ngelixa ama-15% engakhange atyale nto konke konke. Izakhono namandla abasebenzi (ama-51%) nokuchasa kwabafundisi nabasebenzi (ama-50%) zezona zithintelo ziphambili ezichaziweyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 5, uhlalutyo nedatha kwiinkqubo zemfundo nokwenza izigqibo, umsantsa phakathi kokusetyenziswa kwe-AI ziinkokeli ngokwabo nesicwangciso seziko yindawo kanye apho i-Wits AHEAD ixoxela khona izigqibo ezikhokelwa bubungqina, kwinqanaba lenkqubo, malunga ne-AI kwiiyunivesithi.

Inside Higher Ed · Established higher education press; national survey fielded by Hanover Research

entry.title: Record number of graduates pushes youth unemployment to 18.9%
entry.summary:
Intswela-ngqesho yasezidolophini phakathi kwabantu abaneminyaka eyi-16 ukuya kwengama-24 e-China, kungabandakanywa abafundi, inyuke yaya kuma-18.9% ngoAgasti 2026 isuka kuma-17.9% ngoJulayi, ngokwamanani e-National Bureau of Statistics axelwe yi-University World News. Oku kunyuka kulandele inani elingazange labonwa ngaphambili labaphumelele izidanga zeyunivesithi abazizigidi ezili-12.7 kweli hlobo, kwaye lelona nani liphezulu ukususela oko kwatshintshwa indlela yokubala ngo-2023. Ingxelo yalatha kwimfuno ebuthathaka yasekhaya nokwanda kokwamkelwa kwe-AI njengoxinzelelo ekuqeshweni kwabaqalayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, ukuxinana kwabaphumelele izidanga e-China kubonisa ukuba ukwandisa imfundo ephakamileyo ngokwako akuqinisekisi ukungena emsebenzini xa i-AI iguqula imisebenzi yabaqalayo, isifundo i-Wits AHEAD eya kusithelekisa neemarike zemisebenzi zabaphumelele izidanga eMzantsi Afrika nakuMzantsi weHlabathi obanzi.

University World News (from the South China Morning Post) · Established higher education press reporting national statistics

entry.title: Ten-country African university alliance pushes joint research and AI skills
entry.summary:
I-Alliance for Africa Partnership, umanyano lwamaziko ali-12 kumazwe ali-10 aseAfrika olusekelwe yi-Michigan State University, isebenzise intlanganiso yayo yonyaka eDar es Salaam ngomhla wama-22 kuSeptemba 2026 ukubiza uphando oludibeneyo olusondeleyo, nokuba iiyunivesithi zifake izakhono ze-AI kwiikharityhulam zazo. UNjingalwazi Nelson Boniface we-University of Dar es Salaam uxelele abathunywa ukuba ubuchule be-AI ngoku buyimfuneko esisiseko kuye wonke ophumelele isidanga, hayi kwabo babhala ikhowudi kuphela, waza wabongoza ukuba kubekho unxibelelwano olomeleleyo phakathi kweeyunivesithi, ushishino norhulumente ukuze uphando luguqulwe lube kusombulula iingxaki ngokusebenzayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 4 igubungela i-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa. Umanyano lweeyunivesithi zaseAfrika kumazwe alishumi olubeka izakhono ze-AI nophando oludibeneyo kwi-ajenda yalo, lungalindanga izakhelo zangaphandle, ngumzekelo ophilayo wentsebenziswano ewela imida i-Wits AHEAD eyifundayo, kwaye sisikhumbuzo sokuba umsantsa wezakhono welizwekazi ujongwa ngaphakathi.

Tanzania Daily News, via allAfrica · African press wire service

entry.title: Report warns AI adoption in US colleges is outpacing student safeguards
entry.summary:
Ingxelo entsha yenkqubo i-SHAPE ye-Student Defense, eyabikwa yi-Inside Higher Ed ngomhla we-18 kuSeptemba 2026, ifumanise ukuba iikholeji zase-United States zifake i-AI ekwamkelweni kwabafundi, kuncedo lwezemali, ekucebiseni nasekufundiseni ngokukhawuleza kunokuba zakha amanyathelo okukhusela abafundi. Ichonga ukuthambekela okungalunganga kwee-algorithm kwizigqibo zoncedo, izikhewu kubumfihlo bedatha nokulahleka koluntu lokwenyani lokufunda njengeyona mingcipheko iphambili, kwaye ibiza amaziko ukuba amisele imigaqo ecacileyo yolawulo nokungafihlisi phambi kokuba asasaze ngakumbi iinkqubo ze-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, ingxelo luluhlu lokujonga oluphathekayo lweendawo apho ulawulo lwe-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo lusalela emva kwesenzo, oluluncedo ekuvavanyeni isikhokelo se-Wits AHEAD ngokwayo malunga nokungafihlisi noxanduva xa sithelekiswa nenkqubo esele iqhubele phambili ekwamkeleni i-AI.

Inside Higher Ed · Established higher education press

entry.title: UNESCO: over 25 education ministers declare AI must serve the 'common good'
entry.summary:
Abaphathiswa bezemfundo namagosa aphezulu angaphezu kwama-25 abehlanganisene kwi-Digital Learning Week ye-UNESCO eParis bamkele ingxelo edibeneyo ngomhla wesi-8 kuSeptemba 2026 ebhengeza ukuba imfundo kufuneka ihlale ililungelo lomntu kwaye iyinto elungele bonke njengoko i-AI isasazeka kwiiklasi nakwiiyunivesithi. Ingxelo ichaza izinto ezisibhozo eziphambili, kuquka ukugcina iinkqubo ze-AI zinokuphicothwa kwaye ziphantsi kweliso likawonkewonke, nokukhusela ilizwi lootitshala malunga netekhnoloji yeklasi. Icaphule uphononongo lwe-UNESCO apho ama-93% ezifundiswa ayekholelwa ukuba abafundi basebenzisa i-AI evelisayo ukwenza izabelo zabo, yaye ama-63% ayebona ukwehla kwamandla engqondo abafundi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, ingxelo yabaphathiswa yobu bukhulu inika i-Wits AHEAD umlinganiselo ovunywe kumazwe ngamazwe wendlela uxanduva kuwonkewonke kulawulo lwe-AI olufanele lube ngayo, iiyunivesithi nabenzi bemigaqo-nkqubo kazwelonke kuMzantsi weHlabathi abanokuwucaphula ngokuthe ngqo.

UNESCO · UN agency ministerial statement

entry.title: University of Alaska regents weigh a system-wide AI policy for every campus
entry.summary:
I-Board of Regents ye-University of Alaska iphonononge umgaqo-nkqubo oyidrafti we-AI onokufuna ukuba zonke iikhampasi zayo ezintathu zibeke isicwangciso sokuphunyezwa kwe-AI sabafundi, abasebenzi nabafundisi. Idrafti ichaza imigaqo ekhokelayo malunga nokugcina ukugweba komntu, ukukhusela ubumfihlo nokhuseleko lwedatha, nokusebenzisa i-AI ukwandisa ukufikelela kwiinkonzo zemfundo, kunye neeseshoni zokufumana izimvo eziceba ukuqhubeka ekwindla ka-2026 nemvume yokugqibela ejoliswe kwintlanganiso yee-regents kaNovemba.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 6 igubungela i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo. Inkqubo yeyunivesithi kawonkewonke eyakha ulawulo lwayo lwe-AI ukususela kwimigaqo esisiseko, esidlangalaleni nee-regents ziphakamisa imibuzo malunga namandla okubeka iliso, iyimodeli yolawulo eluncedo ekufuneka i-Wits AHEAD iyilandele njengoko iphuhlisa isikhokelo sayo somgaqo-nkqubo.

Alaska Public Media · Public broadcaster report

entry.title: World Bank opens free AI skills training to young people across 44 African countries
entry.summary:
I-World Bank iphehlelele i-'The Job I Hope For', imema abantu abatsha abaneminyaka eyi-18 nangaphezulu kumazwe angama-44 aseAfrika ekuMazantsi eSahara ukuba babhalisele uqeqesho lwasimahla kwi-intanethi kwiziseko ze-AI evelisayo, ukubhala imiyalelo (prompt writing) nemigaqo yokuziphatha ye-AI, olunikezelwa ngesiNgesi nangesiFrentshi ngo-Okthobha 2026. Le nkqubo iphendula kwimeko yelizwekazi apho abantu abatsha abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-600 kulindeleke ukuba bangene kwimarike yemisebenzi ngo-2050, icela abathathi-nxaxheba ukuba baqale bachaze umsebenzi abanethemba lokuwufumana phambi kokuba bakhe izakhono ze-AI zokuwufikelela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 4 igubungela i-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa. Inkqubo yezakhono ze-AI yasimahla yelizwekazi lonke ejolise ngqo kulutsha olungena emsebenzini luvavanyo oluthe ngqo lwendlela uqeqesho olukwinqanaba elikhulu olunokwakhelwa ngayo iimarike zemisebenzi i-Wits AHEAD ezifundayo, kwaye inokuba liqabane okanye imodeli ekufanele ibukelwe.

entry.title: Systematic review finds AI training for future primary maths teachers is still too brief to stick
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucwangcisiweyo (systematic review) lwabaphandi kwiiyunivesithi ezintathu zasePortugal luhlole izifundo ezili-11 ezihlolwe ziingcali malunga nendlela ootitshala bamabanga aphantsi abasaqeqeshwayo abafundiswa ngayo ukusebenzisa i-AI ekufundiseni izibalo. Uninzi loqeqesho luqhutywe njengeeseshoni ezimfutshane eziqhotyoshelwe kwiikhosi ezikhoyo endaweni yeemodyuli eziqhubekayo, kwaye lugubungele ulwazi nge-AI nokuyisebenzisa ngokwenene kakuhle kodwa imigaqo yokuziphatha nohlolo olunzulu zigutyungelwe ngokungalinganiyo, nto leyo eshiya ubungqina obuncinane bokuba izakhono ziyadluliselwa kwiiklasi zokwenyani.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 3 igubungela i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala. Iinkalo ezine eziyimfuneko zolu phononongo, ulwazi, ubuchule nokubhala imiyalelo, ukudityaniswa kwezokufundisa nohlolo olunzulu, zinika i-Wits AHEAD uluhlu oluphathekayo lokuyila umsebenzi wayo woqeqesho lootitshala endaweni yocweyo lwe-AI olwenziwa kube kanye kuphela.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed systematic review

entry.title: New scale measures students' skill at using AI responsibly in assessed work
entry.summary:
Abaphandi kumaziko amathathu e-China baphuhlise baza baqinisekisa isikali esinezinto ezilishumi elinesibhozo esilinganisa ukuba abafundi bemfundo ephakamileyo bayiqonda kangakanani imigaqo yovavanyo, bakuchaza kangakanani ukusebenzisa kwabo i-AI kwaye bayigcina kangakanani ingqibelelo yezemfundo xa besebenzisa i-AI evelisayo kumsebenzi wekhosi. Sivavanywe kubafundi abangama-486 emva koko kwiqela elahlukileyo labangama-798, isikali sibonise ulwakhiwo oluthembekileyo lwemiba emihlanu kwaye sinxulumene ngamandla nendlela abafundi abazibandakanya ngayo nengxelo-mpendulo (feedback) kunye nenjongo yabo yokwenza izinto ngengqibelelo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 1 igubungela i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo: ukufundisa, uvavanyo nengqibelelo. Isixhobo esiqinisekisiweyo esinje sinika amaziko indlela esebenzayo yokulinganisa nokwakha ulwazi lwabafundi malunga novavanyo, endaweni yokuthembela kuphela kwisoftware yokubona okanye kwizithintelo ezigubungela yonke into.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Prescriptive AI model flags Ecuadorian students at highest dropout risk, and what would change it
entry.summary:
Abaphandi kwiyunivesithi kawonkewonke e-Ecuador bakhe isakhelo sohlalutyo olumiselayo (prescriptive analytics), belandela abafundi abangama-2,500 abangena phakathi kuka-2020 no-2024, esingaqikeleli nje kuphela umngcipheko wokuyeka izifundo ngokuchaneka okuphezulu (ROC-AUC 0.95 ukuya ku-0.97) kodwa sikwachonga notshintsho oluncinane olunokwenzeka, olufana nekhredithi eyongezelelweyo kwangethuba okanye ukufikelela okungcono kwi-intanethi ekhaya, olunokususa umfundi kwiqela elisemngciphekweni ophezulu. Amanqaku onyaka wesiseko (foundation year), inkqubela yeekhredithi kwangethuba, ubuthathaka kwezentlalo noqoqosho nokufikelela kwi-intanethi ekhaya zezona zinto ziqikelele ngamandla.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 2 igubungela i-AI nohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lempumelelo yabafundi. Oku kususa uhlalutyo lwesilumkiso kwangethuba ekuphawuleni nje abafundi abasemngciphekweni kusiya ekumiseleni amanyathelo athile angabizi kakhulu, imodeli i-Wits AHEAD enokwalatha kuyo kumsebenzi wempumelelo yabafundi kwiimeko ezinezixhobo ezifanayo.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Largest meta-analysis yet finds AI-supported STEM teaching has a real, moderate effect on learning
entry.summary:
Uhlalutyo-meta (meta-analysis) oluhlanganisa izifundo zovavanyo nezifana novavanyo ezingama-35 lufumanise ukuba ukufundisa okuxhaswa yi-AI kuvelisa impembelelo elungileyo ephakathi nebalulekileyo ngokwezibalo kwiziphumo zokufunda i-STEM (g = 0.67). Inzuzo ibiphezulu kakhulu kubafundi bamabanga aphezulu esikolweni, kwaye amanyathelo athatha inyanga enye ukuya kwezimbini abe lelona xesha lisebenza kakuhle kwalawo avavanyiweyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 3 igubungela i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala. Obu bobunye bobungqina bamanani obucace gca ukuza kuthi ga ngoku bokuba ukufundisa i-STEM okuxhaswa yi-AI kuyasebenza, kwaye isiphumo malunga nobude obufanelekileyo benyathelo siluncedo ngqo kwindlela i-Wits AHEAD eyila ngayo nebeka ngayo amaxesha eenkqubo zayo ze-STEM.

Journal of Intelligence · Peer-reviewed meta-analysis

entry.title: Gates Foundation commits 1 billion US dollars over two years to equitable AI
entry.summary:
I-Gates Foundation yenze isithembiso sobuncinane bebhiliyoni e-1 yeedola zase-US kule minyaka mibini izayo ukwakha nokuhambisa i-AI enolingano, apho izigidi ezingama-400 zibekelwe imfundo, izigidi ezingama-400 impilo, izigidi eziyi-100 ezolimo nezigidi eziyi-100 idatha yoqeqesho lwe-AI kwiilwimi ezingafumani nkxaso yaneleyo. Esi sithembiso sihamba kunye nengxelo yeshumi ye-Goalkeepers yesiseko, enesihloko esithi Make This Matter: AI, Equity and the Choice We Can't Delay.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 6 ibuza ukuba ngubani oyila i-AI ngoxanduva kwaye uyilela bani. Isithembiso sobubele sobu bukhulu, esijolise ekuvaleni umsantsa kwimimandla ehlwempuzeke kakhulu, siya kumisela ukuba zeziphi izixhobo ze-AI kwimfundo eziya kufikelela kwiiklasi zoMzantsi weHlabathi i-Wits AHEAD ezifundayo.

Gates Foundation · Foundation press release accompanying its Goalkeepers report

entry.title: Systematic review of 105 studies finds Africa and Oceania missing from generative AI teacher research
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olukhokelwa yi-PRISMA lwezifundo ezili-105 ezihlolwe ziingcali malunga nootitshala ne-AI evelisayo, ezapapashwa ukususela ngo-2023 kwiijenali eziphambili zetekhnoloji yemfundo, lufumanise ukuba isiseko sobungqina sigxile e-China, eTurkey, e-United States naseSpain, ngelixa iAfrika ne-Oceania zingamelwanga ngokwaneleyo. Ulwazi lwe-AI, ulwazi lwezokufundisa nokuzithemba (self-efficacy), okuchazwe ngemodeli ye-TPACK, zezona zinto ziqikelela ngamandla ukudityaniswa okusebenzayo eklasini, ngaphambi kokufikelela nje kwizixhobo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 3 igubungela i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala. Uphononongo olungaka luqinisekisa ukuba uphando lwe-Wits AHEAD ngokwayo malunga nemfundo yootitshala eAfrika luvala umsantsa obhaliweyo endaweni yokuphinda umsebenzi kwicandelo esele ligcwele.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Stanford study finds a persistent 19% AI employment gap for young workers
entry.summary:
I-Digital Economy Lab yaseStanford ixela ukuba ingqesho phakathi kwabantu abaneminyaka engama-22 ukuya kwengama-25 kwimisebenzi echaphazeleka kakhulu yi-AI ngoku ingaphantsi ngama-19% kwinqanaba ebiya kuba kulo ukuba ibihambisana noontanga abangachaphazeleki kangako, isuka kuma-15% kunyaka ophelileyo. Lo msantsa ubangelwa ikakhulu kukuncipha kokuqesha kunokuba kube kukuphulukana nemisebenzi, kwaye ugxile kwimisebenzi esekelwe kulwazi olucwangcisiweyo olufundiswa ezincwadini, efana nobunjineli besoftware nenkonzo kubathengi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 4 ibuza ukuba i-AI iyiguqula njani indlela esuka kwisiqinisekiso iye kwindlela yokuziphilisa. Obu bobona bungqina bamanani bucacileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku bokuba imisebenzi yabaphumelele izidanga yabaqalayo esekelwe kulwazi iyancipha kuqala, nto leyo eyomeleza isizathu somsebenzi wesakhono sabaphumelele izidanga odlula kwiziqinisekiso.

Stanford Digital Economy Lab · University research institute report

entry.title: New Global South framework sets conditions for responsible generative AI in teaching
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwe-bibliometric nolucwangcisiweyo kwi-International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning lulandela uncwadi olukhula ngokukhawuleza malunga ne-AI evelisayo enoxanduva kwezokufundisa luze luphakamise isakhelo-ngqiqo soMzantsi weHlabathi. Lufumanise ukuba imveliso yophando ikhokelwa yi-United States, i-China ne-Australia, ngelixa luchonga ukuqonda imigaqo yokuziphatha, ukuthembana, inkxaso yeziko, ukulungela kweziseko zophuhliso nobuchule be-AI njengezona meko zibumba ukwamkelwa.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 6 igubungela i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo. Esi sakhelo sinika i-Wits AHEAD indawo yembekiselo ehlolwe ziingcali yokugweba ukuba ukwamkelwa kwe-AI evelisayo kwiiyunivesithi zoMzantsi kunoxanduva ngokwenene na endaweni yokuba kufumaneka nje.

International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds 15-year-olds who skip AI chatbots for schoolwork outscore those who rely on them, as global reading skills fall sharply
entry.summary:
Iziphumo ze-PISA 2025 ze-OECD, ezakhutshwa ngomhla wesi-8 kuSeptemba 2026, zibonisa amanqaku okufunda esehla ngamanqaku angama-28 kumazwe e-OECD nangamanqaku ali-16 kwamanye amazwe nezoqoqosho ezithathe inxaxheba phakathi kuka-2015 no-2025, okunye kokwehla okukhulu kakhulu ukususela oko lwaqala olu vavanyo. Ingxelo ifumanise ukuba abafundi abaneminyaka eli-15 abangasebenzisi ii-chatbot ze-AI kumsebenzi wesikolo ngokuqhelekileyo bafumana amanqaku aphezulu kunabo bazisebenzisayo, nokuba ngaphezulu komfundi omnye kwabane bathi abafundi afunda nabo baphazanyiswa zizixhobo zedijithali kwizifundo ezininzi okanye kuzo zonke zesayensi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: INtsika 5, uhlalutyo nedatha kwiinkqubo zemfundo nokwenza izigqibo, ifumana apha uphawu olucace gca kwinqanaba leenkqubo: uvavanyo lwehlabathi oludibanisa ukuthembela kakhulu kwii-chatbot ze-AI neziphumo ezibuthathaka, isilumkiso i-Wits AHEAD esilinganisa ngqo nomsebenzi wayo weNtsika 1 malunga ne-AI evelisayo ekufundiseni nakuvavanyo.

OECD (PISA 2025 Results, Volume I) · Intergovernmental body report
